lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple columns of high-luminance, roughly circular spots arranged in a staggered grid posterior to the gill slits. Spacing between spots within a column is relatively uniform.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity align with the columns of high-luminance spots, forming a series of anchor nodes where the spots reside within the lighter bands.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible running parallel to the longitudinal axis on the upper flank, each defined by a sharp luminance gradient transition from high intensity on the ridge peak to low intensity in the ventral shadow.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a significantly higher density of smaller, more compact high-luminance spots compared to the larger, more widely spaced blobs on the lateral flank.
